description: A productivity and project management platform for organizing tasks, docs, goals, and team collaboration.
auth_notes: Supports personal tokens (starting with pk_) for individual testing/use and OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for public apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free ClickUp account and self-serve generate personal API tokens or create OAuth apps via settings.
api_notes: Covers comprehensive task management, custom fields, views, comments, webhooks, and general workspace resources.
mcp_notes: ClickUp publishes an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to connect AI assistants directly to ClickUp.
rationale: ClickUp features a broad public REST API, self-serve free credential generation via user settings, and an official MCP server.

evidence.note: Details personal tokens and OAuth 2.0 flow configuration.
